pages.text: Can be used to create spells by placing spell parts in a spell circle. Spells consist of at least one effect and a spell type.
They can be cast by using a Manaweaver's Staff after adding the Spell Runes to it at a Runewrought Bench. Spells can be toggled by pressing 'U'.
You can also augment spells with modifiers. Spells are read from the center outward and should follow the pattern type > effect/modifier > modifier.

Self -> Cast on the caster, Touch -> Casts on the block/entity being touched, Projectile -> Casts in a straight line until it hits a block/entity, Rune -> Places a rune on the ground which function like a mine, Rune Widen -> Increases Rune Radius, Rune Delicate -> Makes rune harder to detect.
